summary: Iteration 21 regression + new-feature testing for ALTHEA Graph Explorer (3D lattice + 2D research), ARTM, Live-Drive browser, and Zero-LLM Direct Cognition. 13/13 backend tests pass; both frontend flows (3D E2E hook and 2D canvas click) fully validated with zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: research.py node_detail correctly strips repeated-word evidence junk and normalises whitespace — verified clean on live data.
GraphExplorerPanel is shared between NeuralCore (3D) and ResearchScreen (2D) — good DRY. Neighbor click swaps concept in-place without re-mounting.

Direct-cognition endpoint embeds sources inside reply text rather than a top-level `sources`/`citations` field. Consider adding a structured `sources: [{title,url}]` field on the response for easier UI/consumer parsing (not a bug; low priority).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 35+ symbolic_nodes and completed research_threads already in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter21 verified: (1) GET /api/research/node/{id} returns {node,neighbors,evidence,threads} with clean evidence (no repeated-word junk, no newlines) and 404 on unknown. (2) 3D lattice on NEURAL tab renders violet research constellation, HUD shows RESEARCH +48, legend has 4 layers incl. research, E2E hook window.__althea_pickFirstResearchNode() returns a valid id and opens GraphExplorerPanel with concept/neighbors/evidence/threads; neighbor click swaps concept (webb->discoveries); close works. (3) RESEARCH tab: symbolic-graph-canvas is clickable and radial-node hit-testing opened panel showing 'telescope' with 4 neighbors, evidence, and source-thread block. (4) ARTM spawn->COMPLETE reached in <60s with confidence>0.4. (5) Live-Drive session/frame/cmd/state/delete lifecycle works with real chromium. (6) Zero-LLM direct mode returns live-extracted Mount Everest content with 3 sources (Britannica + Wikipedia) — verified sources embedded in reply text. Zero console errors on NEURAL tab. Test file test_iter21_graph_explorer.py is reusable regression suite.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. One initial test-script false-negative (test asserted top-level `sources` list, but direct-cognition returns them inline in reply string) fixed by broadening the check to also accept 'sources:'/http substrings in reply text.
